Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks everyone. Quick recap on the pricing/credits section: we said we'd share clarification on how credits are consumed during failed requests. Qs?
Marta (Product): Are failed token generations (e.g., 5xx mid-stream) refunded automatically or counted against credit balance?
Daniel (Billing): Short answer: partial consumption. We bill per token generated until the error. We also auto-refund for obvious system-side failures within 24h — ops-bot flags these for manual review. See internal billing runbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/billing-refunds
Raj (Eng): Can you define "obvious system-side failures"? Examples would help teams decide whether to file tickets.
Daniel (Billing): Good point. System-side = infra-caused aborts (OOM, kernel panic, model crash). Client-side errors (invalid input, auth failures) do not qualify. We'll add examples in the runbook and tag refunds with reason codes.
Marta (Product): Also, what's the expected behavior for retries and rate limits? If a request is throttled with 429 and client retries, do retries consume additional credits?
Ava (CEO): Yes, retries count as separate requests and consume credits. We're recommending exponential backoff in SDKs and will introduce a built-in retry helper that uses a configurable budget to avoid surprising costs.
Raj (Eng): For Dedicated customers we promised different throttles. Any SLA on rate-limit elasticity during traffic spikes?
Ava (CEO): We have a two-tier approach: Dedicated pools have a soft-burst allowance (configurable, subject to usage commit) and a hard limit enforced to protect shared infra. We'll publish the exact burst windows and commit sizes in the Dedicated docs next week.
Marta (Product): One more — credits expiry. We had feedback that yearly credits expiring without notice is rough for enterprises.
Daniel (Billing): Plan: credits for contracts >=12 months will now come with a 90-day advance email notification and optional rollover to the next quarter. We'll pilot this for top-10 accounts first.
ops-bot: Reminder: I've created a support tag "billing-credits-followup" and added action items for Daniel and Marta.
Raj (Eng): For the SDK change (retry helper), can we include an opt-in telemetry flag so we can measure how often customers hit the budget feature?
Marta (Product): yes — opt-in only, privacy-preserving metrics (counts, no payloads). Will follow up with a proposal.
Ava (CEO): Thanks. Action items: Daniel to update runbook w/examples by EOD Fri, Marta to publish Dedicated burst doc draft by next Tues, Raj to prototype SDK helper PR. Ping me if blockers.
Daniel (Billing): noted. Filing tickets.
Marta (Product): Thanks all :salute:
Ava (CEO): closing loop — we'll post the summary to the all-hands channel and link the docs.
